{{Top}}
[[File:Bio-Scanner.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Rebel using a portable bio-scanner]]
A '''bioscan''', or '''bioscanner''', was a [[Sensor/Legends|scanner]] that was designed to detect and assess lifeforms. It could detect the presence of a lifeform in the area, along with their location<ref name="Journal4Scanners">{{JournalCite|4|Cracken's Rebel Field Guide: Scanners}}</ref> and a rundown of their vital signs.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> With the appropriately loaded information in the bioscan, the unit could determine the lifeform's [[Species/Legends|species]]. Bioscanners were calibrated to detect lifeforms approximating [[Human/Legends|Human]] size; creatures smaller than that range were harder to detect, while it was easier to discern larger creatures.<ref name="Journal4Scanners" />

On the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] homeworld of [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], most buildings were equipped with bioscanners. The devices could be used to tell the relative status of everyone on the premises based on the number of jewels implanted on their bodies.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
